title: Recreating a Parents’ Favorite 3-Course Meal as Vegan (Valentine’s Day) – Cheesecake, Panna Cotta, Scallop Pasta

locations.name: Parents’ house, Connecticut, USA
locations.basis: Transcript explicitly states the creator is at her parents’ house in Connecticut.

locations.name: Goodfellas, New Haven, CT, USA
locations.basis: Transcript names this restaurant as the parents’ favorite; used as a comparison, not as filming location.

summary: In a Valentine’s Day themed kitchen project, a creator documents cooking a vegan three‑course replica of her parents’ favorite restaurant meals while visiting them at home in Connecticut. The video centers on: (1) a dairy-free amaretto cheesecake with a coconut-cashew filling and a baked graham crust using a water bath, (2) a panacotta-inspired vegan appetizer with homemade vegan parmesan, and (3) a main of king oyster “scallop” pasta with a red pepper sauce, leveraging mushroom physics, miso-lemon-nori marinade, and a roasted garlic sauce. The host tests the recipes, improvises salt and water adjustments, and invites her parents to taste and compare with the restaurant versions, offering commentary on texture, flavor, and overall impression. Evidence of technique includes specific steps like crust pressing, baking times, water bath creation, cashew-coconut fillings, agar-set parmesan, and blended sauces.

sections.title: Amaretto Vegan Cheesecake (crust to bake)
concepts: Cashew–coconut filling with miso and lemon
Use of silken tofu and cornstarch to firm filling
sections.description: The creator begins the vegan three-course plan with the amaretto cheesecake. She grinds graham crackers with organic sugar and coconut oil to form a crust, lines a parchment-lined springform, presses the crust flat, and bakes it at 350°F for 8–10 minutes before cooling. For the filling, a food processor blends cashews, full-fat coconut milk, amaretto, lemon juice, and miso, then adds cornstarch and silken tofu, blending until ultra-smooth. The crust is baked first, then the filling is prepared, poured, and set up with a water bath by placing the springform in a larger baking dish with 1 inch of boiling water.

sections.title: Appetizer Prep: Vegan Parmesan & Panna Cotta Base
sections.description: While the cheesecake chills, the video moves to the appetizer. The host makes a quick vegan parmesan from cashews, macadamia nuts, nutritional yeast, and toasty preparation. She then prepares an agar-based dairy-free “parmesan” mixture by heating refined coconut oil with agar, adding miso for tang, and shaping it into a small mold that will later grate over the panna cotta. The next step turns to the panna cotta base: cashews, coconut milk, amaretto, lemon juice, miso, sugar, and cornstarch are blended until smooth, then the mixture is set in a mold and chilled in the freezer for 1–2 hours.

sections.title: Main Course: King Oyster Mushroom Scallops & Red Pepper Pasta Sauce
concepts: Mushroom marinade with nori, lemon, miso, sugar, salt, rice vinegar
Toasting ciabatta bread and incorporating in sauce?
Garlic and shallot base for pasta sauce
Roasted garlic for sauce and peppers blend
Blending to create smooth red pepper sauce
Searing mushroom scallops with vegan butter
sections.description: The main course focuses on mushroom scallops fashioned from large king oyster mushrooms. Tops are trimmed, mushrooms are cut into scallo p shapes, and a marinade is prepared with a torn nori sheet, lemon juice and zest, white miso, organic sugar, salt, rice wine vinegar, and a neutral oil. A separate broth-based mixture with water, lemon, nori, sugar, soy sauce simmers before the mushrooms are added to marinate for 2–4 hours. The ganache and cheesecake components are set aside as the scallops marinate. For the pasta sauce, the host roasts a head of garlic at 400°F for 35–40 minutes, then sautés shallots and garlic, blends with roasted red peppers, coconut milk, nutritional yeast, cornstarch, paprika and seasonings, and returns the sauce to the pan to thicken slightly. The marinated mushrooms are seared in neutral oil and finished with vegan butter to impart a buttery aroma, then the pasta is tossed with the red pepper sauce.

sections.title: Dessert: Amaretto Dairy-Free Cheesecake with Chocolate Ganache
concepts: Chocolate ganache with dark chocolate + coconut milk
sections.description: Parallel to the main course, the dessert path is described. The chocolate ganache is prepared by microwaving dark chocolate chunks with full-fat coconut milk, then stirring in amaretto. The cheesecake is retrieved from the fridge, unmolded, and topped with a glossy chocolate ganache that drips over the edges. Fresh raspberries are added as a finish. The parents compare the vegan cheesecake to the restaurant version, noting texture and flavor differences, and rate the dessert highly.

sections.title: Tasting, Feedback & Closing
sections.description: The video captures parents sampling the courses, commenting on texture and flavor. Appraisal focuses on the vegan cheesecake, the panna cotta-style parmesan topping, and the mushroom scallop pasta, with praise for the vegan substitutions and the wine pairing cue in the room. The host thanks the viewers and signs off with Valentine’s Day well-wishes.
